mode: Dated public reports · not a live feed

global.label: species threatened worldwide
global.detail: 49,505 of 175,909 assessed species were threatened in the July 2026 release. Threatened means Vulnerable, Endangered or Critically Endangered; these are not recorded extinctions. The Red List does not assess every species on Earth.

kew.label: of flowering plant species estimated at risk globally
kew.detail: A model-based global estimate from Kew's 2023 report, not a continent count or a count of extinct species. Retained as a dated research reference, not presented as the latest Kew report.

regions.name: North America
regions.label: U.S. plants at risk
regions.scope: United States plants assessed by NatureServe; not a North American total.
regions.detail: NatureServe reports 34% of U.S. plant species at risk of extinction. Its conservation-status system is distinct from IUCN categories.

regions.name: South America
regions.label: tree species threatened
regions.scope: South American trees: 13,668 species assessed; not all species on the continent.
regions.detail: 3,356 of 13,668 assessed tree species in South America are at risk of extinction.

regions.name: Europe
regions.label: wild bee species threatened
regions.scope: European wild bees; not a count of all threatened European species.
regions.source: IUCN · European Red List of Bees
regions.detail: The 2026 report identifies 172 European bee species as threatened, including 14 flagged as Possibly Extinct. Possibly Extinct is not a confirmed extinction.

regions.name: Africa
regions.label: tropical flora potentially at risk
regions.scope: Tropical African vascular plants in a preliminary model; not a formal continent-wide Red List count.
regions.source: Stévart et al. · Kew and research partners
regions.detail: The study estimates 31.7% of tropical African vascular plant species as potentially or likely threatened. This is a preliminary automated assessment, not confirmed extinctions.

regions.name: Asia
regions.label: Indo-Burma plants threatened
regions.scope: 2,979 assessed plant species in Indo-Burma; not an Asian total.
regions.detail: The report states that 522 of 2,979 assessed Indo-Burma plant species are globally threatened. Data sources were accessed in June 2021 (report pages 46–49).

regions.name: Oceania
regions.label: Australian species listed threatened
regions.scope: Australian plants and animals listed threatened; not an Oceania-wide count.
regions.detail: The government release describes almost 2,000 Australian plant and animal species listed as threatened. This national listing is distinct from a global IUCN assessment.

regions.name: Antarctica
regions.label: highlighted species now Endangered
regions.scope: Two named cases: emperor penguin and Antarctic fur seal. Not a total for Antarctica.
regions.detail: Both species were reported as Endangered in April 2026. This label highlights the two reassessments in that release, not all threatened Antarctic species.
